7/S0.subgoal: Describe the four distinct phases of augmented reality evolution.

7/S1.subgoal: Explain the key developments and technologies during the experimental phase of AR.

7/S2.subgoal: Describe the academic research and early system milestones during the basic research phase of AR.

7/S3.subgoal: Explain the development of tools, wearable systems, and mobile AR during the tools and applications phase.

7/S4.subgoal: Describe the transition to commercial AR applications and summarize the historical evolution of the field.
